name: casestudyhub
description: CaseStudy Hub - AI-Powered Case Study Presentation & Assessment Platform

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-casestudyhub --config firebase/firebase.json "STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:9199 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.build:e2e: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-casestudyhub.firebaseapp.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-casestudyhub NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=demo-casestudyhub.appspot.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID=1:1:web:e2e NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 npm run build && node scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e && cd firebase && npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-casestudyhub "cd .. && node e2e/seed.mjs && npx playwright test"
